prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Fermium (Fm) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one horizontal 3:2 image, 1536×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a small repair kiosk with a cluttered workbench, a low stool, tools hanging on the wall and an open shutter onto the street
Time of day: daytime indoors — bright, even light filling the room; daylight bouncing softly off pale walls.
Hair: her hair let down loose over her shoulders — same colour and length as the attached image.
Light direction: backlit — the main light comes from behind her, a bright rim along her hair and shoulders.
Outfit: a flowing West African boubou — a wide floor-length embroidered robe with a matching head wrap — in deep amethyst purple; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; right now — strong light from behind passes through the thin outer fabric, so the outline of her figure shows as a soft silhouette inside it; the inner layer stays fully opaque, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: walking.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; back to the camera; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side.
PROP: with her own right hand she carries a small black graphite block with one warm ember glowing in a hollow at its centre, wrapped in a frost-white cloth low at her side; it is all she holds.
LEGS: mid-stride, one heel lifting.
GAZE: she looks toward the far distance.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — fermium: element 100, the first to reach three digits, found together with her twin einsteinium in the fallout of the first hydrogen-bomb test in 1952, and named for the physicist who lit the first nuclear reactor, a pile of graphite blocks stacked in a squash court beneath the stands of a university sports field in the winter of 1942; she is the end of the road for building heavier elements by feeding neutrons to a reactor, because the next step splits apart almost at once, a wall no neutron can climb; her longest-lived form lasts only about a hundred days, and no one has ever gathered enough of her to see — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: keep her exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.
